name: Telekinesis

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a Huge or smaller creature or an object you can see within range

sustain.label: Telekinesis: move it again
sustain.help: A Magic action: seize a creature within 60 ft again (Strength save).

summary: Move a Huge or smaller creature with your mind: Str save or it is moved up to 30 feet and Restrained.
text: The creature stays Restrained (held aloft if lifted) until the end of your next turn. When you cast it and as a Magic action later, you can move a creature again or move or handle an object of up to 1,000 pounds.
